name: ring-carousel
summary: Cards on a 3D ring you spin with a swipe; it snaps and loops forever.
props: Render a card. `active` is true for the card facing you.
Turn every 3s (or N ms); pauses while touched.
Fires when the front card changes.
behavior: Horizontal drags spin the ring and a flick carries it a little further before snapping. Tapping a side card turns to it; tapping the front card calls onPress.
Neighbours turn, shrink and fall into shadow as they go round the back. With autoplay it advances every 3s by default and pauses while touched.
The ring is one adjustable element ('2 / 7'): swipe up or down to turn it, double-tap to press the front card. Side cards are hidden.
The loop runs on the native driver via Animated.modulo. Each card turns in its own flat layer so iOS never slices a side card into the front one.
